purpose: Evaluate exactly one pre-specified H2 timing intervention: shift Q019 signal availability from record_date to auction_date, then map to the first XNYS session strictly after auction_date.

event_source.signal_definition: Signed change in bid_to_cover_ratio versus immediately preceding 10-Year event: positive=+1, negative=-1, unchanged=0.
event_source.source_pit: Q025 validates auction_date as the fixed date-level public-information anchor for the result.

intervention.only_change: Replace first XNYS session strictly after record_date with first XNYS session strictly after auction_date.

trading_rule.exposure: On the first eligible XNYS session strictly after auction_date, hold the event signal for that session only; outside event sessions exposure is zero.
trading_rule.mapping: +1 = equal-weight long across all 12 assets; -1 = equal-weight short across all 12 assets; 0 = flat.
trading_rule.sizing: Each active asset receives 1/12 gross exposure; total gross exposure fixed at 1.0; no leverage.
trading_rule.overlap: If multiple events map to the same session, aggregate signed event signals arithmetically and use sign(sum).

authorization.condition: Set true only after the fixed universe passes fresh coverage and a frozen snapshot fingerprint is bound to this preregistration and source-contract fingerprint.
